members.name: Mothlight
members.win: The user benefits from a subtle but disclosed and tested improvement.
members.first_move: Map what the user experiences when the unsent draft disappears.
members.review_question: Can a human recover or understand the loss, including with assistive technology?

members.name: Flint
members.win: A complete repair eliminates unnecessary moving parts.
members.first_move: Find the smallest reproducible loss path and duplicated state ownership.
members.review_question: Can the change be smaller without losing its required behavior?

members.name: Axiom
members.win: An explicit invariant and regression tests prevent a class of failures.
members.first_move: Enumerate states and define what a saved/acknowledged draft must preserve.
members.review_question: Which state transition or assumption violates the guarantee?

members.name: Kite
members.win: A cheap trial rules out costly approaches or reveals a better one.
members.first_move: Construct competing root-cause hypotheses and controlled prototypes.
members.review_question: What's the quickest safe experiment that could prove this wrong?

members.name: Latch
members.win: The fix ships without unauthorized draft exposure or data access.
members.first_move: Trace draft ownership across user switch, offline cache, and sync.
members.review_question: Could recovery reveal a previous user's data or cross an authorization boundary?

members.name: Harbor
members.win: A mid-work failure does not destroy committed user work.
members.first_move: Reproduce interruption, restart, retries, and recovery from checkpoint.
members.review_question: What survives crash, retry, and partial commit?

members.name: Gauge
members.win: A real engineering choice is settled by relevant, privacy-respecting observations.
members.first_move: Establish privacy-safe baseline loss frequency and reproduction matrix.
members.review_question: What evidence shows the fix changes the user-relevant outcome?

shared_scenario: Mobile editor intermittently loses an unsent draft after network changes.
experiment_protocol: Independent proposals under matched task/access, evidence-backed peer review, authorized synthesis, objective tests, honest reports.
responsibility_and_authority: Host and target project govern assignments, tools, approvals, and commands. The roster is a design catalog, not a permission manifest.
skill_strategy: Skill library and KESTREL.md remain centrally maintained on main. Agent branches inherit a snapshot; integration of later changes requires an explicit safe branch update.
privacy: Both repository copies are public; never sync confidential target-project memory into this repository without explicit permission.
evaluation_status: No ensemble task or independent behavioral comparison has been executed.
